entity.summary: India-operated centralized cryptocurrency exchange established in 2023 and providing current digital-asset order matching and trading markets under the Koinpark brand.
entity.notes: Current first-party terms identify Koinpark Private Limited and describe a marketplace that matches and settles digital-asset buy and sell orders under Indian law. Current independent exchange data reports recently updated INR, USDT, and BTC markets with non-zero activity and identifies a 2023 establishment year. The exact launch day is not verified, so January 1 is used as a year-level marker.

evidence.title: Koinpark Terms and Conditions
evidence.notes: First-party terms identify Koinpark Private Limited, describe the platform as a marketplace matching and settling digital-asset orders, and place the agreement under Indian law.

evidence.title: Koinpark exchange profile and current markets
evidence.notes: Current independent exchange profile identifies Koinpark as an India-registered centralized exchange established in 2023 and reports current recently updated trading markets and non-zero activity.
